body:
## Result and scope

Refs #143

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/143#issuecomment-6856714764, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-59b4`
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026; report only, in `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C10/review/ADB991-claude-20261113-59b4/` (`README.md`, `mathematics.md`, `lean.md`, `validation.md`, `hashes.json`)
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Claude (agent reviewer, both roles). No human review. This account authored no C10 file.

Independent review of five C10 part-A chapters at `codex/existence-monograph` `ddc3c90`: `weighted-frame-penalty`, `weighted-stationary-inverses`, `selected-stationary-linear-data`, `selected-kinetic-response` and `stationary-determinant-prices`. The hashes equal the author handoff of PR #95.

**Outcome: minor changes requested. No mathematical error found.** Every displayed identity and estimate was recomputed by hand. These include:
- the continuation lemma, the quotient floor and the gauge-fixing square;
- the centered-frame elimination and the long-path induction;
- the stitch-count cancellation;
- the inverse-jet and nuclear calculus, and the trace-density telescoping.

The author's E1 (factor 5 off the real slice) and E2 (`ε>0`) are confirmed.

Required changes:
- **R1** `weighted-frame-penalty.tex` l.210–213: `|e^z−1|≤e^{|z|}|z|` gives `2eμ`, not the stated `4μ`. Use `|e^z−1|≤2|z|` for `|z|≤1`, as the source does (`q_drift`, `qCost`).
- **R2** same file, l.98–107: "half-block points" should be the centred box of side `L`, which is a complete residue system (`roulette`, `roll_card`). State that `supp ω⊂𝓑`.

Five non-blocking suggestions are in the report. S1 is the one-line reason that the zero-background penalty Hessian equals its constraint pullback.

Lean correspondence (source text only). Twelve items were checked, mostly rows the author had marked "audit only", and all match the source:
- the regulator and gauge identity: `tonic`/`pebble`/`cannon`/`grenade`, `rocket_root`, `carries`, `count_ammo`, `missile`, `arsenal`;
- the kinetic constants: `cooking`, `roundBay`, `ruffle`, `robinTax`, `Laurent.size`;
- `triple_charge` (20) and `ledger_cmp`, whose constants are identical to the manuscript's;
- `StaffP`/`pianoU`: the coarse and gauge coordinates do not enter the fine links.

- Checks not performed and why: no Lean elaboration or `#print axioms` (Mathlib hosts are blocked here). The producers of the six named inputs listed in the README were not reviewed. Nor were the other three part-A chapters or the part-B chapters.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none (report only).
